ABOUT KOTA STONE

What is Kota Stone?

Kota Stone is a fine-grained natural limestone sourced from Kota, Rajasthan, widely recognized for its earthy shades of blue, green, grey, and brown. Known for its excellent durability and natural texture, this stone has remained a preferred material for flooring and architectural applications for decades.

Its strong composition, low maintenance, weather resistance, and elegant appearance make it ideal for both indoor and outdoor spaces. Available in natural, polished, and honed finishes, Kota stone continues to be widely used by architects, builders, and homeowners seeking durable natural stone flooring solutions.

HAVE QUESTIONS?

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about Kota Stone, from durability and maintenance to applications, pricing, and long-term performance.

What is Kota Stone?

Kota Stone is a fine-grained variety of natural limestone quarried in Kota district, Rajasthan, India. It has been used for flooring for over 200 years and is known for its exceptional durability, natural slip resistance, and low cost. It comes in grey, green, and brown natural color variations depending on the specific quarry area.

Which Kota Stone finish is best for my project?

The best finish depends on your use case: Natural finish is ideal for heavy-traffic outdoor areas, courtyards, and pathways where slip resistance is priority. Satin finish is best for premium interior spaces – living rooms, hotel lobbies. Semi-polished balances visual appeal with grip for covered areas. Resto (Restoration) finish is perfect for heritage, farmhouse, resort, and rustic aesthetics. Contact us on WhatsApp and our team will guide you to the right finish.

Is Kota Stone suitable for outdoor use?

Yes – Kota Stone is one of the best natural materials for outdoor applications in India. Its natural cleft texture provides excellent grip even when wet. It is unaffected by heavy rain, direct sunlight, extreme heat, and frost. It has very low water absorption, making it perfect for courtyards, pathways, gardens, terraces, and landscaping.

What thickness is available?

All our Kota Stone variants are available in approximately 20mm thickness, which is the standard recommended thickness for both flooring and wall cladding applications. This thickness provides the ideal balance of strength, weight, and ease of installation for all project types.

Do you provide bulk supply for large projects?

Yes, absolutely. Jain Stones & Tiles specialises in bulk supply for large residential, commercial, and infrastructure projects. We maintain large ready stock at our Kota facility and can supply thousands of square feet with consistent quality and colour matching. We have supplied for projects from 500 sq ft to 50,000+ sq ft.

Do you offer delivery across India?

Yes – we offer PAN India delivery from our facility in Kota, Rajasthan. We have shipped to Maharashtra, Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Gujarat, Delhi NCR, and all major states. All stone is properly packed in wooden pallets to prevent breakage in transit. Freight charges vary by destination.
